import math

lat1, lon1 = 37.7749, -122.4194

lat2, lon2 = 42.3396, -71.0693

# Haversine formula
R = 6371  # Earth's radius in km
dlat = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
dlon = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)

c = 2 * math.asin(math.sqrt(a))
dist_km = R * c
dist_miles = dist_km * 0.621371

print(f'From:  (37.7749, -122.4194) — San Francisco, CA')
print(f'To:    4829 Elm Ridge Way, Suite 7, Boston, MA 02118')

print(f'')
print(f'Straight-line (great-circle) distance:')
print(f'  {dist_km:,.1f} km')
